lines.zh: 我在红石线上一节一节爬。
lines.en: I crawl along the redstone line, segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我的壳里透出暗红的光。
lines.en: A dull red light leaks through my shell.

lines.zh: 六条腿踩过导线，没有声音。
lines.en: Six legs cross the wire without a sound.

lines.zh: 我顺着矿道的墙往前挤。
lines.en: I squeeze forward along the mine wall.

lines.zh: 我越走越亮，像一小段电路。
lines.en: I brighten as I go, like a length of circuit.

lines.zh: 别用手抓，我会钻进石头。
lines.en: Do not grab me; I will slip into the stone.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方，红石粉湿了。
lines.en: The redstone dust dampens where I crawl.

lines.zh: 我闻到矿脉深处那股甜味。
lines.en: I smell that sweetness deep in the vein.

lines.zh: 我停在岔口，挑更红的那条。
lines.en: I pause at the fork and pick the redder path.
My antennae keep reaching ahead.
The crack in the stone is wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 我走得很急，像在赶信号。
lines.en: I hurry as if chasing a signal.
The lines on my back flicker on and off.

lines.zh: 我绕过火把，光让我发晕。
lines.en: I skirt the torch; its light makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 我沿着矿车的轨道往深处爬。
lines.en: I crawl the minecart tracks downward.

lines.zh: 红石粉在脚下发烫，我吃得快。
lines.en: The dust runs hot; I feed fast.

lines.zh: 我缩在矿洞里，装成一颗砂砾。
lines.en: I huddle in the tunnel, posing as a grain of gravel.
Redstone dust dims at my feet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢咀嚼最后一截导线。
lines.en: I chew the last stretch of wire slowly.

lines.zh: 我在数自己身上的光点。
lines.en: I count the lit spots on my body.
The stone is cool; my shell is hot.

lines.zh: 吃饱的我，会让机关乱跳。
lines.en: A well-fed me sets your contraptions jumping.
My belly presses against the vein.
I hear a piston moving far away.
Full, I cannot be bothered to move.
I am waiting for a new circuit.

lines.zh: 我把触角收在壳边歇着。
lines.en: I tuck my antennae against my shell to rest.
The whole tunnel is humming.

lines.zh: 你的镐刚碰到我的石头。
lines.en: Your pick just touched my stone.
The torch in your hand is too bright.
I am staring at your redstone dust.

lines.zh: 你放下的线路，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the line you laid.
Do not blink; I will vanish.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝里有红石屑。
lines.en: There is redstone grit in your armor seams.
I watch you because you dig accurately.
You are standing on my home.

lines.zh: 你的口袋在响，是红石吗。
lines.en: Your pocket rattles; is that redstone?
I lift my head and my shell flares once.
My shell dented and my glow dimmed.
You snapped the leg on my left side.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起矿石裂开。
lines.en: That reminded me of ore splitting.
Do not press me against the stone.
My light is leaking out.
You snapped my antenna.
It hurts so much I burrow into the crack.
The smell of redstone mixes with my blood.
My shell ticks as if about to split.

lines.zh: 再打，我就什么都不剩了。
lines.en: Another hit and nothing of me remains.
Redstone dust; sprinkle a little this way.
I could eat that entire line.

lines.zh: 你手里的方块在发红光。
lines.en: The block in your hand glows red.
I smell redstone; do not hide it.

lines.zh: 给我一节导线，我跟你走。
lines.en: Give me a length of wire and I will follow.
What is inside a repeater counts too.

lines.zh: 我馋的是能通电的东西。
lines.en: What I crave is anything that carries current.
Set the redstone down and I will appear.
I can finish an entire line.
Do not fool me with iron ingots.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，我钻进了石头。
lines.en: You stepped on me and I sank into the stone.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的靴尖上，弹开了。
lines.en: I hit your boot tip and bounced away.

lines.zh: 别挤，这条缝只够一只虫。
lines.en: Do not crowd; this crack fits one bug.
I crawl under the sole of your boot.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我抖了抖。
lines.en: We collided and I shuddered.
You touched my antennae.
You kicked me half a foot away.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，纯属意外。
lines.en: My grip on your trouser leg was an accident.
After the bump I glowed for half a second.
Move; I am going back into the mine.

lines.zh: 我们在矿脉里碰了碰触角。
lines.en: We touched antennae inside the vein.
Her glow is a little dimmer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们把卵塞进红石矿里。
lines.en: We tuck our eggs into the redstone ore.

lines.zh: 两条线路，两只虫，各吃一头。
lines.en: Two lines, two bugs, one end each.
When she finishes eating she hides in the stone.

lines.zh: 我们不看对方，只交换信号。
lines.en: We do not look at each other, only trade signals.
The young hatch already with teeth.

lines.zh: 我们靠红石的气味找彼此。
lines.en: We find each other by the smell of redstone.

lines.zh: 我们一明一暗，像在对暗号。
lines.en: One bright, one dim, like a coded exchange.

lines.zh: 分完这条线，我们各走各路。
lines.en: Once the line is shared, we part ways.
I pick up a grain of redstone dust.
I am dragging this piece back to my burrow.
Holding it, my light grows brighter.
The dust you dropped is mine now.

lines.zh: 我拖不动整块，只好咬碎。
lines.en: I cannot drag the whole block, so I bite it apart.
I stuff it beside my jaw.
Crumbs cling to my legs.
I gathered along the way and ate half.
That block is too hard; I give up.
I keep it hidden and give it to no one.
Someone is disturbing my vein.
A pickaxe is my dinner bell.
The current in that line has changed.
Who is tearing my home apart?
I see redstone dust flashing.
Footsteps are on the wire.
Target spotted; my shell heats up.
You broke open my stone.
I turn my head toward the noise.
Someone is placing a repeater.
I smell an unfamiliar hand.
That line belongs to me.
I will bite through your wire first.

lines.zh: 你退后，我会跳上你的腿。
lines.en: Back off, or I jump onto your leg.
My light grows brighter and brighter.
Go on, dig one more time.
I am watching the pick in your hand.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的影子找落脚点。
lines.en: I follow your shadow looking for a foothold.
I hug the ground, ready to charge.
Your torch will not hold me back.
Three seconds and I am there.

lines.zh: 我缩成一小颗，准备弹出去。
lines.en: I coil into a pellet, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 吃饱后我能送出十级信号。
lines.en: When full I put out a signal of ten.
Hold still while I pick a landing spot.
I bite your finger.

lines.zh: 这一口带着红石的涩味。
lines.en: This bite tastes of bitter redstone.
I bounce off the back of your hand.
My teeth are small but hard.
I wedge into your armor seam.
You shook your hand and I flew off.
I bit through your wire.
Consider that a light one.
I am inside your sleeve now.

lines.zh: 我咬开一道口子就退回缝里。
lines.en: I tear a small opening and retreat into the crack.
The stone split and I fell out.
I had been sleeping inside redstone ore.
Your pickaxe woke me.
I smelled open air for the first time.
Too bright; I shrink back first.

lines.zh: 我从矿脉的缝里钻出半个身。
lines.en: I push half my body out of the vein's crack.
My shell has not hardened yet.
All red around me; I relax.

lines.zh: 谁把我挖出来的，我记住了。
lines.en: Whoever dug me out, I remember.
I landed and went looking for wire.
Fire makes my shell pop and crackle.

lines.zh: 我从矿石上摔下来，腿断了一根。
lines.en: I fell from the ore and snapped a leg.
Water puts my light out.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的矿脉一起掀了。
lines.en: The blast tore up my vein with me.
An arrow pinned me to the stone.
Magic tastes like a cut circuit.

lines.zh: 没有红石，我的光越来越暗。
lines.en: Without redstone my glow fades.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我亮得像颗太阳。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I shone like a sun.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有红石，我什么都吃不到。
lines.en: There is no redstone in the void, nothing to eat.
